protocol.method: Full float64 SVD PCA on mean-centered hidden h; no neuron-wise scaling; each model fit independently.
protocol.variables: All 256 hidden units; c not analyzed.
protocol.statistics: Means/SEM across eight paired training seeds; differences descriptive, no p-value screening.
protocol.limitation: Linear variance is not gridness, topology, intrinsic manifold dimension, dynamical stability, or behavior. Fixed/variable replay conditions differ in several factors.
